verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no explicit AI-training policy or opt-out. It does show GlitchTip can be self-hosted with Docker, which keeps error data under the user's own control. The built-in MCP server is also described as letting you pull your own data into AI tools "with no data sharing required," which implies a privacy-preserving posture without stating anything about model training. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that hosted customer data is not used to train AI models, a documented training opt-out or contractual guarantee, and independent corroboration.
